description: When: a diff is ready for review. Gives: likely bugs in the added lines (with the diff line), risk score with every factor named, impacted areas, test cases to add, credentials added by the diff (BLOCK, masked previews), and with commit_message its Conventional Commits check. PASS / CONDITIONAL / BLOCK. Deterministic, no model call. Does not prove: that the change is correct; only a credential is a hard rule, the rest is triage.

examples.git_diff:
diff --git a/src/pay.js b/src/pay.js
--- a/src/pay.js
+++ b/src/pay.js
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+const total = price * qty;

commit_message.description: Checked against Conventional Commits; an invalid one makes the verdict CONDITIONAL at most.

context.description: Optional PR title or description for richer analysis

git_diff.description: Unified git diff (output of `git diff HEAD` or copied from GitHub diff view)

name: run_pr_gate_pipeline
